sections.description:
RECRUITMENT RULES OF NATIONAL
RECRUITMENT RULES OF
NATIONAL
HIGHWAYS AND MOTORWAY POLICE
(Amendment of R.2)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
22nd December, 2011]
S.R.O.1106(I)/2011,
dated 8-12-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-rule (2) of rule
3 of the Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973, the
following amendments shall be made in the Recruitment Rules of National Highways
and Motorway Police, notified vide S.R.O. 237(I)/07, dated 2nd March, 2007,
namely:--
In
the aforesaid Recruitment Rules;
In
rule 2, (Method of Appointment),
(i) The
existing entries against Sl.No.2 under columns 3 and 5 shall be substituted by
80% and 20% respectively.
(ii) The
existing entries Sl. No.3 under columns 4 and 5 shall be substituted by 80% and
20% respectively.
2. This
Notification issues with the concurrence of the Establishment Division O.M.
No.3/1/99-R-5 dated 28-11-2011.
